reported.quote: If you look at the per branch metrics, we are about INR 330 crores per branch currently.
And if you go back to the FY’23 time period, we were INR 266 crores per branch.
We have already as of 30th of June had a disbursement in that scheme of close to INR14,000 crores under the ECLGS scheme.

quarter_margin.name: NIM
quarter_margin.quote: So, now we are almost down to 3.4 odd percent.
